top_violation_types.title: Center Heated, Lighted and Ventilated Properly (26 TAC §746.3407(10))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the inspection, certain areas of the center exhibited low temperatures. Two thermostats indicated readings of 60 degrees and 64 degrees, while the external temperature was recorded at below 40 degrees.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child's file was missing a health statement.

top_violation_types.title: Designating Director (26 TAC §746.201(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has not designated a qualified director.

top_violation_types.title: Report Change in Controlling Person (26 TAC §746.305(a)(7))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Controlling person list is not being kept current.  Previous director no longer present at this center has not been removed as a controlling person.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Benefits (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policy did not include information related to the promotion of indoor and outdoor physical activity.   The operation corrected at inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One out of four employee records evaluated was unavailable for review.     One out of four employee records evaluated was incomplete.

top_violation_types.title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The Director was lacking current transportation training. The operation provides transportation.
